prompt: Complete a static paint method that fills a right-pointing arrow (shaft plus triangular head) as a single seven-point java.awt.Polygon. Follow the vertex list in the starter Javadoc exactly.
explanation: A Polygon is just a list of points that Java2D closes automatically, so seven vertices traced around the outline describe the shaft and the head as one shape -- no separate rectangle and triangle needed. Ordering matters: the points must walk the outline, because jumping back and forth would make the edges cross and the fill would come out wrong. fillPolygon paints the interior of that closed outline.
hints: Create the Polygon with its no-argument constructor and build it up with addPoint.
Add the points in exactly the listed order -- they walk around the outline clockwise.
Do not draw a separate rectangle for the shaft; the same polygon covers both parts.
